text: This might be a silly one. I'm a childminder and I've got a 2 month old boy with me tonight while his parents are at a family thing. He felt a bit warm so I checked and he's 38.1. I'm not sure if that counts as a proper temperature for a baby that small or if I'm making a fuss about nothing. I've messaged his mum but she hasn't seen it yet. Should I be doing something?
